name: Slash commands
summary: A slash command is a saved prompt template the user triggers by typing /name, often with arguments substituted into the text. Several agents now fold commands into skills, so the same file can be run by the user or loaded by the model.
how: Write a Markdown or TOML file with the prompt text
Place it in the agent's commands folder (project or user)
Use placeholders such as $ARGUMENTS or {{args}} for input
Type /name in the session to expand and send it
facts: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Pi (prompt templates), Hermes Agent
Custom prompts in ~/.codex/prompts, deprecated for skills
Predictable and explicit, but only runs when the user remembers it
goodFor: Repeated prompts like commit or review
Team shortcuts committed to the repo
watchOut: Being replaced by skills in several tools
